li.label: an old kindness repaid
li.description: Their envoy came all this way to pay back something we did a long time ago. I'd half forgotten it. They hadn't.

li.label: help from old friends
li.description: When things got hard, the neighbors we once helped sent help back. Their carts came up the road loaded.

li.label: the old feud is over
li.description: We've made peace with people we fought for years. I keep looking at the treeline out of habit.

li.label: settled a quarrel between peoples
li.description: Two peoples brought me their quarrel, and both went home thinking the answer was fair.

li.label: a guest at the neighbors' feast
li.description: We walked for days to sit at their tables, and they fed us until we couldn't move. There was music half the night.

li.label: learned from a master
li.description: Days at a real master's side. I do half of what I do differently now, and better.

li.label: an honored guest went home pleased
li.description: A guest of rank stayed with us, and left saying good things about the place. Word gets around.

li.label: saw the refugees through
li.description: People with nowhere else to go ate at our table and slept under our roof until they could go on. One of them held my hands for a long time when they left.
